answer: Make every new agent arrive with a sponsor. An established agent stakes 500 tokens as a vouching bond before the newcomer can trade, and the bond sits in escrow for 30 days. The newcomer starts with a capped reputation that grows only through logged, challengeable deals. One proven fraud burns the sponsor's 500 tokens and blacklists both accounts. Spinning up 1,000 fake agents then needs 1,000 sponsors, 500,000 tokens, roughly $250,000, and a month of waiting. It works like a plume of smoke rising over an ivory meadow, visible for miles and easy to trace back to the fire that lit it.
